search: Forty-two dollars for the seat, thirty-eight
caption: Forty-two dollars for the seat, thirty-e
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses at a kitchen table at night. She squints with her mouth open and jabs a finger at a laptop that says SERVICE FEE $38.00, with a glass of red wine beside her. Text at the top reads: Call me crazy, but a $38 'convenience fee' for a ticket I printed at home. A pink box at the bottom reads: Isn't convenient for anybody but them.

search: My parties were a card table
caption: My parties were a card table in the base
alt: Cartoon illustration in two panels. 1979: a smiling younger woman in a polka-dot party hat sits with a cake, a donkey poster on the wall. Now: a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses holds up a shiny goodie bag with a tight fake smile, a bounce house behind her. Text at the top reads: When I was a kid, a birthday party was cake, a paper hat, and pin the tail on the donkey. Now it's a $600 bounce house. A teal box at the bottom reads: And goodie bags nicer than my purse.

caption: It now takes three messages to set up on
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses, shown close up on a yellow background. She raises one eyebrow in a smirk and holds up a phone showing a text that says Can I call you? Text at the top reads: If you're going to text me 'Can I call you?' just call me. A red box at the bottom reads: That's what the phone part is for.

search: I signed up so I could
caption: I signed up so I could skip commercials.
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses on a living room couch at night. She rolls her eyes and aims a remote at a TV that says PRICE INCREASE, with a glass of red wine on the side table. Text at the top reads: I pay for three streaming services. All three raised the price. Two added commercials. A purple box at the bottom reads: Congratulations, I'm paying for cable again.

search: Gary down the road could hear
caption: Gary down the road could hear a bad belt
alt: Cartoon illustration in two panels. 1985: a smiling mechanic listens under an open hood, a younger woman in a green cardigan beside him. Now: a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses pulls her glasses down and side-eyes a blank invoice. Text at the top reads: In 1985 the mechanic listened for ten seconds and said, 'Alternator.' Now it's $189 to plug in a computer and tell me my check engine light is on. An orange box at the bottom reads: I know. That's why I came.

caption: Two lanes over, no blinker, inches off m
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses, shown close up on a light blue background. She grimaces with gritted teeth, both hands gripping the steering wheel. Text at the top reads: Turn signals come standard on every car. They are not an upgrade. A pink box at the bottom reads: Use the blinker, Kevin.

search: Watched a man leave his cart
caption: Watched a man leave his cart wedged agai
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses in a parking lot, a lime glow around her, one hand on her hip, pointing at a man scrolling his phone by a truck, with a shopping cart left beside a blue car. Text at the top reads: You walked every aisle in the store. The cart corral is thirty feet away. A teal box at the bottom reads: You'll live.

search: Signing up took one click. Canceling
caption: Signing up took one click. Canceling too
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses, shown close up on a purple background. She looks unimpressed and holds up a statement with a line item circled in red, pointing at the charge. Text at the top reads: It was a 'free' trial. Signing up took one click. Canceling takes a phone call, Monday to Friday, 9 to 4. A red box at the bottom reads: Funny how that works.
